caption: The drawing consists of a square composition featuring three red geometric flowers with pointed petals, each accompanied by straight, green stems and angular green leaves. The flowers are arranged diagonally across the square, with each flower oriented in a slightly different direction, and their green stems converge near the bottom right of the square. The background of the square is a light beige color, divided into sections by faint intersecting lines. The drawing is centered on a larger plain, off-white background, and the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" appears in small, capitalized letters beneath the square composition.
title: Quilt Block Pattern
